searchText: hi guys, not sure wher eto ask this, i seemed to have corrupted my eth DB when a sync connectivity issue occured.. is there a clean/fast way to resync geth? `geth removedb` ah great! thanks! what is the difference of `geth removedb` and rm -rf the chaindata dir? `geth removedb` does not remove the ancient blocks, you could do `rm -rf chaindata/*.ldb` > "not sure where to ask this" There's a Geth Discord server if you have more questions about it. https://discord.gg/4T4nx26z

excerpts.content: what is the difference of `geth removedb` and rm -rf the chaindata dir?

excerpts.content: `geth removedb` does not remove the ancient blocks, you could do `rm -rf chaindata/*.ldb`
